t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Focus more on the colour of the gnomes and how much mushrooms come from each. Use this knowledge to choose the right colour on the 5x rounds if can. Sometimes the colour of the gnome and its payoff reverse so try to keep an eye out for patterns.

vb_textbox.text: Pay attention to the colours of the gnomes and how many mushrooms they give out. Try and use the 5x on the gnomes with the higher mushrooms. They do switch up sometimes and it revolves around more of a pattern on which side the gnomes are on, just try and pay attention to when it switches.
